business_summary.text: KSH International is a manufacturer of magnet winding wires, including continuously transposed conductors (CTC) for power transformers, serving over 120 OEM customers with exports to four continents.

call_points.text: FY27 volume growth guided at least 21%, matching FY26, with full-year Supa capacity.
EBITDA per tonne sustainable at ₹65,000-70,000 long term.
Installed capacity 43,445 MT at March 2026; Supa Phase II to take it to ~59,000 MT in FY27.
Green copper backward integration project expected to commence in H2 FY27.
Specialised wires EBITDA per tonne about 3x standard wires; mix shift drives overall margin.
Operating leverage from new capacity expected only after Q4 FY27.
Debt-to-EBITDA improved to 0.39x in FY26 from 1.21x in FY25.

guidance.statement: FY27 volume growth of at least 21%, matching FY26.
EBITDA per tonne sustainable at ₹65,000-70,000 long term.
Supa Phase II capacity to be completed in FY27, taking installed capacity to ~59,000 MT.
Green copper backward integration facility to commence in H2 FY27.
Payable days targeted to improve beyond 25 to close to 30 days by end of FY27.
